messages:
maya: Heads-up: RC build starts in ~2h (lock in 1h). We're locking release branches — please avoid non-critical merges. If you need a late merge, file an exception now: ping @release-bot with the PR link, add the label `merge-exception`, and include a short risk summary + changelog delta. No behavioral changes after lock unless explicitly approved. Also, docs-only bumps need changelog owner confirmation. 🕐
aj: Is PR 49321 (docs: version bump) okay to land? small, doc-only, no runtime changes.
maya: @aj please add a short changelog blurb in the PR body and tag @sam for docs-owner confirm. If release-bot sees `docs-only` and `changelog` it'll auto-approve. Otherwise we need manual ok.
aj: done — added 'chore: bump SDK version in docs' and changelog snippet
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/49321
release-bot: Exception request recorded: PR 49321 by aj — labels: docs-only, changelog-present. Automated checks: CI pending (build/test). If CI passes, will queue as docs-only fastpath. :gear:
zhou: Heads up — flaky in integration-test/orders that just popped on main. If we're close to RC I recommend we avoid merges touching the network stack; consider cherrypick if isolated.
maya: @zhou thanks — good call. @aj if your PR touches none of that, ok. If not, rebase onto release branch and I'll consider a cherrypick after smoke.
aj: No net changes — docs only. CI green locally. Thanks.
sam: Confirming changelog ok from docs side. :+1: Please keep version bump to patch per semver for docs-only.
maya: Great — once CI shows green I'll tag and merge. Reminder: if anyone needs a behavioral late merge, add risk assessment, test plan, and get explicit owner signoff. We'll only accept high-priority fixes. Thanks all.
